integrity.proof_scope: Complex geometric integrality, complete singularity support, nodal Hessians, genus, Tjurina numbers and generic canonical double cover
integrity.verification: Exact symbolic identities reproduced by check.py; geometric completeness and birationality proved separately

scientific_limitations: All assertions are over the complex numbers and require nonzero lambda and s and lambda squared different from four.
The singularity stratification excludes the lambda-squared-equals-four nontransverse-base regime and the nonreduced s=0 member.
The smooth canonical bielliptic description holds only off the three outer-node walls.
Oka–Pho previously classified all the named singularity baskets; the exact wall arrangement and explicit normalization equations are the compared contribution.
No independent mathematical audit has been performed; differently parameterized unindexed sources remain a priority risk.
title: Exact nodal walls and a bielliptic canonical model for a symmetric torus-sextic family
